title: Convert to PDF from images, text, Markdown, HTML and Office
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-convert; A-28 creates PDFs from images, text, Markdown, HTML and Office files and the result opens with real page count and text
notes: Library half of the convert-to-PDF pair per ADR 0012. Serves acceptance item A-28 (Convert to PDF creates PDFs from images, text, Markdown, HTML and Office files) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Wires the existing creation paths to a document-level entry point that takes the source file and options, writes a PDF, and proves each input kind on a real file reopened with PDFium (page count, size and extractable text where the source has text). Office input uses the documented subset and reports typed unsupported constructs rather than faking them. A serialised app shell task follows once this lands and owns the Convert tool in crates/pdfxi-app/src/shell/**; matrix rows stay `library` until that shell task verifies them.
